pitches.logline: Nodar, a retired teacher, wants his mechanic to tell him what is wrong over the phone. All he can send is his own mouth imitating the engine.
pitches.hook: Nodar crouches by the idling crossover with the phone at his mouth and makes the engine noise himself while the real engine shakes beside him. Sound real-rough-idle.

pitches.logline: Gela, a young architect, thinks he beat the check light by unhooking the battery. The light keeps coming back, each time at a worse moment.
pitches.hook: Gela yanks the battery terminal with a hard clunk, the dash goes dark and he punches the air. Sound real-clunk.

pitches.logline: Zura, a night taxi driver, becomes the airport rank's scanner. Everyone queues for his verdict until the last car he checks turns out to be his own.
pitches.hook: A horn blasts and a colleague slaps Zura's window, yelling for him to check his car first. Sound horn-short.

treatment.logline: Gela, a young architect, thinks he beat the check light by unhooking the battery. The light keeps coming back, each time at a worse moment.
treatment.hero: Gela, about 30, in a navy denim jacket with round glasses and short curly hair, and his graphite crossover, in his own garage every shot
treatment.obstacle: he believes switching the lamp off fixed it, so he never asks why it lit

hook.event: Gela yanks the battery terminal with a hard clunk, the engine lamp dies and he throws his fists up

act1: the next morning he starts the car in the same garage and the amber lamp blooms back on the cockpit
he unhooks the battery again while the old neighbour by the bumper drops his face into his hand, and the lamp comes back
his boss gets in for a ride, the engine starts and the lamp lights a third time right in front of her
treatment.turn: a held beat after the third return, then one plain line: switching the light off is not a repair; if the cause stays, the code comes back

reveal.what: the phone rises slowly out of the dark, then Gela crouches at the open door and the adapter's light wakes in the socket under the wheel

screens.step: the black OBD scanner card, tap scan
the app reads the car, no internet
can I drive: the answer, the reason and the deciding code

treatment.payoff: the same garage, bonnet shut, the boss beside him: Gela holds out the phone with the code and says he will not touch the battery again
treatment.signature: a tally of amber engine lamps over every act 1 shot, one more lighting with each return, then the scan's one code behind all three
